attacks.claim: The QA table reports the staff pilot week as already passed (64 staff cards, real holds, 0 misdelivered texts, 2 copy fixes re-verified). The Rollout section schedules that pilot for Nov 2-6, and the gate date is 2026-10-26, so the pilot has not run. Either the result is mis-stated or the pilot gate has no real evidence behind it. The QA header also says all QA ran on staging with the provider in test mode, which does not match a pilot using real holds.
attacks.evidence: QA: "Staff pilot week (64 staff cards, real holds) | 0 misdelivered texts; 2 copy fixes shipped and re-verified" vs Rollout: "1. Nov 2-6: flags on for staff cards only (pilot above)."

attacks.claim: The announcement says text alerts are available "for every cardholder", but the option is opt-in and is not shown on juvenile cards. Juvenile cardholders will read the announcement and then not find the option.
attacks.evidence: "Text alerts for holds, for every cardholder." vs "juvenile cards do not show it"

attacks.claim: The pre-announcement smoke test (one live text and one locker pickup per branch) has no stated failure path. It does not say whether the announcement is held, who decides, or whether the flags are rolled back.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: action if the smoke test fails before the 10:00 announcement
